title: Direct tax mop-up grows over 14% to over ₹5.21 lakh crore on higher advance tax payments
description: Net corporate tax collection rose 22% to ₹2.08 lakh crore, and mop-up from net non-corporate tax, which includes taxes paid by individuals, HUFs, firms, grew 8% to about ₹2.94 lakh crore till June 17
